messages:
maria_csm: weekly check-in for Saffron — quick signal readout for caching + batching (TL;DR: hit rate up a bit, avg batch size too low, cost still above target)
ashok_csm: thanks — got the summary?
maria_csm: pasted the numbers below from last 7d vs prior week: 
- cache hit rate: 18% → 23% (up 5pp)
- avg batch size: 2.1 tokens/request → 2.4 (still tiny; goal 6+)
- p50 generation latency: 210ms → 190ms
- error rate (5xx/token errors): 0.12% → 0.18% (regressed)
- cost per 1k tokens: $5.10 → $4.85 (down 5%)
- spend run-rate: $12.4k/wk → $11.8k/wk
kevin_sre: nice hit rate bump. where is the error spike coming from? any correlation with batching windows?
julia_data: looking — errors cluster around 03:00-05:00 UTC on two days; 90% from model fallback paths (variant mismatch)
maria_csm: customer still on client-side immediate flush setting (no waiting). they dispatch ~70 concurrent tiny requests when users paste text.
nashok_csm: that explains small batch size. we recommended 50ms jitter in onboarding playbook — did they apply it?
maria_csm: not yet. onboarding checklist shows step 4 incomplete (client batching).
kevin_sre: if they flip to 50-100ms window we should see avg batch size go up and cost drop further. but watch for transient queuing; set max_wait=200ms to protect latency SLA.
julia_data: ran a quick sim against their request distribution: median batch size jumps to ~5 at 75ms, 7+ at 150ms. estimated cost per 1k tokens falls to ~$3.60 at 150ms assuming current hit rate and quantization.
maria_csm: great. also we should tackle the fallback errors — looks like model routing tried a smaller-quant model and client couldn't parse an incompatible response schema.
kevin_sre: workaround: add an explicit model-variant header so routing never sends the q4 variant until we confirm schema parity. I'll add a routing rule.
nashok_csm: risk to renewal? what's the sentiment after these numbers?
maria_csm: customer is neutral-positive. primary ask: reduce per-request cost and keep latency under 250ms. If cost stays >$5/1k they'll escalate. currently 4.85 is okay but they want <4.0.
julia_data: suggested experiment: enable client batching (50ms), enable prefix caching for common greetings (TTL 24h), and deploy routing rule to pin model variant. projection: hit rate +10pp, avg batch size 6, cost ~3.8/1k.
kevin_sre: timeline: I can push routing rule today (done by EOD). maria, can you own client rollout nudges?
maria_csm: yes — I'll send enablement guide + a short code snippet.
maria_csm: snippet to share with Saffron (JS):
```
const queue = [];
let timer = null;
function sendWithBatch(req) {
  queue.push(req);
  if (!timer) timer = setTimeout(flush, 50); // 50ms batching window
}
function flush(){
  const batch = queue.splice(0, queue.length);
  timer = null;
  api.sendBatch(batch);
}
```
nashok_csm: perfect. add note: set max_wait param to 200ms in prod.
kevin_sre: routing rule created: model_variant=stable-q8 pinned for Saffron org (will not fall back). deploy-bot: routing-rule/saffron pin applied 
deploy-bot: routing-rule/saffron pin applied — rollout id r-20240322-11 ✅
julia_data: I'll schedule a small smoke eval after client change to confirm output schema and recalibrate cache keys.
maria_csm: action items — maria: send snippet + enablement doc (today); kevin: monitor errors & routing rule (done); julia: run smoke eval (tomorrow); ashok: tag renewal alert if cost >$4.5 at next check (weekly).
nashok_csm: agreed. meeting next week same time to review numbers.
maria_csm: thanks all — I'll ping Saffron and update the onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:
